## Introduction

## Data Wrangling

```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r reading-in-data, include=TRUE, message=FALSE}
monomer <- read_csv("protein-datasets/monomer_dataset.csv")
homodimer <- read_csv("protein-datasets/homodimer_dataset.csv")
homotrimer <- read_csv("protein-datasets/homotrimer_dataset.csv")
homotetramer <- read_csv("protein-datasets/homotetramer_dataset.csv")
```

glimpse(monomer)

glimpse(homodimer)

glimpse(homotrimer)

glimpse(homotetramer)

```{r mono-col_rename, include=TRUE}
monomer <- monomer %>% 
  rename(Intrasubunit_HBonds = Intrasubunit_HBonds.1) %>% 
  mutate(chain_name = NA)
```

```{r}
homotetramer %>% 
  select(code, PDB_ID, Entity_ID)
```

```{r homo-tetra_col-remove, include=TRUE}
homotetramer <- homotetramer %>% 
  select(-PDB_ID, -Entity_ID)
```

```{r bind_rows-for-all-data, include=TRUE}
proteins <- bind_rows(monomer, homodimer, homotrimer, homotetramer)

proteins %>% 
  arrange(desc(chain_name))
```

```{r naming-subunits, include=TRUE}
proteins <- proteins %>% 
  mutate(subunit_type = case_when(nsub2 == 1 ~ "monomer", 
                                  nsub2 == 2 ~ "homodimer", 
                                  nsub2 == 3 ~ "homotrimer", 
                                  nsub2 == 4 ~ "homotetramer")) 
```

```{r organizing-dataset, include=TRUE}
proteins <- proteins %>% 
  select(-nsub2) %>% 
  relocate(chain_name, .after = code) %>% 
  relocate(subunit_type, .after = chain_name)
```
